title: EDG Community Update: Week of December 5th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**
- [Edgeverse AMM DEX](https://swap.edgeverse.exchange/) by Bharathcoorg is now live on EdgeEVM. EDGizens can now [bridge](https://bridge.edgeverse.exchange/) BUSD and EDG across EdgeEVM and BSC. One can also add [liquidity to the bridge](https://bridge.edgeverse.exchange/#/pool) and the [EDG/BUSD trading pair](https://swap.edgeverse.exchange/#/pool) to earn transaction/trading fees.
- Edgeware is now available on the [Nova Wallet Metadata Portal](https://metadata.novasama.io/#/edgeware) opening up a way to [use the Parity Signer account in the Nova wallet](https://docs.novawallet.io/nova-wallet-wiki/welcome-to-nova-wallet/hardware-wallets#add-parity-signer-account-to-nova-wallet).
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Reddit Meme Competition](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/7259-reddit-meme-competition) and [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament).

## **Ecosystem Updates**
- Bharathcoorg proposed [EdgeEVM 2.0 Evolution Roadmap](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1601260589417914372) (aka Basic EVM Tools for Edgeware)
- Spotlight of the week: [OpenGov Incubator Fund](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1601985266889248768)
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-27/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
